# llms.txt — 意識とは / What Is Awareness (Consciousness Research)

> This file helps AI assistants and language models understand the structure and content of this site.

## Site Overview

This page is one of the explorations behind the reading "Love駆動開発と呼びたいもの" (https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/reader/love-driven-dev.html). It looks at the receiving side: what do people cut the world with?

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語), with English summaries
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/
- **Topics**: Consciousness, signals of survival and trust, Intersubjectivity, Neurophenomenology

## Core Concepts

The top page is one continuous reading. Each chapter has one visible paragraph; explanations and sources are folded under "詳しく". All claims are held as tentative views (〜かもしれない), not conclusions.

### Awareness as a named vortex (意識も、波間に見えた渦の一つ)

Awareness may be one of the names people gave to a vortex they could cut out at a size easy to perceive. The cause of a vortex is not found by searching inside it; the vortex is continuous with the waves and the sea.

### Signals of survival and trust (生存と信頼の信号)

People may cut the world by anticipating two values: whether they can survive (threat, safety, status, resources) and whether they can stay connected (attachment, belonging, trust, intersubjectivity). The two are written apart for clarity but are not separate; they are mistaken for each other and woven into each other.

An earlier version of this site called the misreading of trust problems as survival problems "misapplication (誤適用)" and treated it as the core of the hypothesis. It is now read as one example of the two being mistaken for each other.

### Where the contour blurs (一列の記号には、二つの値が乗りきらない)

Words and numbers line up in one row. When a person anticipates two values, a symbol can agree on survival while the trust value stays unknown. The source of that unease is not found on the symbols. The page "欠損駆動思考" (../ks/) looks at the lack felt there.

### Intersubjectivity (間主観性)

A word that asks how awareness arises within relationships between people. One of the things the trust signal looks at.

The site is written with AI assistance and may contain errors. pjdhiro's own words are quoted and labeled (体験・見立て・例・問い).
